title: Asking Bill Matthews for a replacement and Andrew's trouble
summary: Barnes tells how he told a bandleader named Bill Matthews to find a replacement, and mentions Andrew being held back for lack of ability.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: I'll play it up one week. One week only I'll play it. I'll be fine, listen. I'll play it. I told him, Bill, get somebody. Please, you've got to get somebody.
Which band was that then? From Bill.
I told him, get somebody. I want to quit the middle. Oh man, what I'm going to do, I ain't got time to get nobody more. I'll be tired when that's right to the Cleveland. It was right.

Well, all right, I'll play the night, I'll play the pro night off. You understand? But be certain somebody. Yeah. That's why they got Andrew up there. They didn't want Andrew up there. They hold him up there a long time up there because he couldn't play enough credit. They wanted credit up there. You see? So he said up there until Sydney come back. Like Trinity.
